summary: Healthcare Services Group filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, disclosing a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire all equity interests of NexDine, LLC and Xendella, LLC, collectively NEXDINE Hospitality, from Real Artisan Brands, LLC and other seller parties. Aggregate purchase price is approximately $93.5 million, subject to customary adjustments, plus contingent consideration tied to post-closing performance conditions, funded with cash on hand. The filing includes customary representations, warranties, covenants and termination provisions, with the purchase agreement and October 7 press release attached as exhibits.
